snippet.title: House Flipper: Remastered Collection – Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: House Flipper: Remastered Collection rolls every DLC (including the HGTV and Apocalypse DLCs that hadn't yet been released on consoles) into one package for the home-remodeling sim. It also adds better lighting and graphics, an improved save system, six new jobs and houses, new mechanics and quality-of-life improvements, and more. It'll be released on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S this Winter. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3710840/
